objective: モバイル向けのViTモデルをCPUからキックさせて動作させ、ImageNetで正答率を検証する。
weakest_point: The repository has CPU-kick and hybrid RTL-proxy evidence, but it does not yet contain a selected mobile ViT model, ImageNet validation input manifest, labels, model weights, ViT execution harness, or top-1/top-5 accuracy report.

source_scan.result: no repo-owned MobileViT/ViT model, ImageNet validation dataset, labels, weights, or accuracy flow found

reusable_cpu_kick_evidence.scope: real Ibex CPU path can MMIO-kick the existing LLM proxy, but not a ViT model

reusable_nn_rtl_evidence.scope: useful datapath and runtime evidence, but not model-level ViT inference or ImageNet accuracy

deliverables_required_for_completion.name: select_one_mobile_vit_model
deliverables_required_for_completion.acceptance: Exactly one mobile-oriented ViT-class model is selected with source, license, input resolution, preprocessing, class label mapping, and expected reference accuracy recorded.

deliverables_required_for_completion.name: prepare_imagenet_eval_manifest
deliverables_required_for_completion.acceptance: A reproducible manifest points to ImageNet validation inputs or an explicitly scoped subset, labels, preprocessing, and evaluation count without committing raw dataset content as source of truth.

deliverables_required_for_completion.name: define_cpu_kick_control_contract
deliverables_required_for_completion.acceptance: CPU-visible registers or commands define load/config/kick/status/result semantics for the selected ViT path.

deliverables_required_for_completion.name: run_first_smoke_inference
deliverables_required_for_completion.acceptance: At least one image runs through the CPU-kicked path and produces deterministic top-k logits or class IDs compared with a CPU reference.

deliverables_required_for_completion.name: run_imagenet_accuracy
deliverables_required_for_completion.acceptance: Top-1 and top-5 accuracy are reported with dataset size, model checksum, preprocessing, command line, and output report path.

non_claims: not MobileViT or ViT model execution
